title: Value insights for Copilot Cowork in Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center introduces a Value tab for Copilot Cowork, providing dashboards on credit use, estimated assisted employee hours, active users, and task categories. Available worldwide mid-September 2026, it helps admins analyze usage patterns and communicate Cowork's organizational impact with updated methodologies.
body:
[What and why:]

We’re introducing the Value tab for Copilot Cowork in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This dashboard brings together Copilot credit consumption, estimated employee time assisted, active user activity, and task category details so admins can identify usage patterns and communicate the potential impact of Cowork within their organization.

The details provided in the Cowork dashbaord are calculated using a methodology optimized for Cowork.

[Rollout schedule:]

- - Release Type: Frontier mid-September 2026- Cloud environments: Worldwide[Impact on your organization:]

After this update is available, admins can open the Microsoft 365 admin center and go to Copilot > Cowork > Value to review high-level Cowork results for a selected reporting period.

The dashboard supports the following time views:

- - Month to date: Data from the first day of the current calendar month through the latest available data refresh.- Rolling last 28 days: Data for the most recent 28-day period through the latest available data refresh.Admins can review:

- - Total credits: The number of Copilot credits used by Cowork during the selected period.- Cowork Assisted hours: A directional estimate of employee hours that benefited from Cowork during the selected time period. These estimates are calculated using an updated methodology that categorizes activities into common types of work and applies estimated time impacts informed by productivity research and observed usage pattern. Learn more about the updated methodology for calculating Cowork Assisted hours: Cowork_Methodology_2026-09.pdf- Active Cowork users: The number of active Cowork users during the selected period.- Credits spent by task category: A breakdown of users, assisted hours, and Copilot credit consumption across different types of work. Supported categories include:- Analysis and research- Document and content creation- Email workflows- Meeting workflows- Communication workflows- Specialized workflows- Code generation and debugging- General assistance and Other workThese insights can help leaders, admins, and adoption teams better understand usage patterns, identify high-value scenarios, and communicate the impact of Copilot Cowork across their organization. Learn more about the definitions for task categories: Cowork_Methodology_2026-09.pdf

Learn more about this feature: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=2378687

[Action required / Recommendations:]

Review the Value tab when it becomes available and determine how the metrics can support your organization’s adoption, consumption, and value reporting. Consider sharing the dashboard definitions with teams that use Cowork data for business reviews or internal communications.

When communicating Cowork assisted hours, describe the metric as an estimate based on task classification and typical time impact. Avoid presenting assisted hours as an exact measurement of employee time saved.

Compliance considerations

Does the change alter how admins monitor, report on, or demonstrate compliance activities?Yes – introduces new administrative reporting and value insights for Copilot Cowork usage.
